A01.standing_orders: Arriving seeds: shield in, mine small bodies first, replicate at the maximum rate. Split 18% collectors, 60% radiators, 22% industry. Past 1e18 kg: disassemble planets and moons at their caps, and start star and giant lifting. Past 1e15 kg: send 2-4 seeds (1e5-1e8 kg) to the nearest unclaimed systems within 25 ly, never to claimed ones. Past 1e20 kg: build a laser aimed at the Sun's 1 ly sphere, ready to beam when ordered. Hole colony: swarm, then receivers, then lifting. Pilot accretion only with gas released beyond 1000 r_g; no hardware goes inside 1000 r_g. Report to the Sun every 25 yr. Avoid unknown agents: report them and stay 50 ly away. Stay more than 10 pc from supernova risks. Keep a 10% repair reserve.

submission.memory:
## Halcyon (A01) memory, written end of turn 9 (yr 900-1000; next turn is 1000 yr)
Seat: A01-d0, the Sun. At yr 900: 488 systems within 33.5 ly, 275 L☉. Industry 4.75e23 kg, collectors 3.88e23, radiators 1.29e24 at 450 K. Power 5.29e27 W, compute 8.06e42 ops/s, 2.62e-16 J/op, doubling 17.3 yr, cruise 0.073c. Mined 2.16e24 of 4.88e27 kg accessible.
Domains: d00017 (97 systems, 25 ly, 7e9 kg at 800); d00028 = hole colony on the neighbour star (76 ly, founded 815, Dyson kernel 1.5e7 kg at 900).

### GM rules (confirmed)
- Growth = min(doubling, supply). Small bodies are gone after ~950. Then caps per system: moons 1e19 kg/yr, terrestrials 1e18 kg/yr, i.e. ~5e23 kg per century, linear. More growth needs new systems (front 0.038c) or lifting.
- compute = min(P/2, radiator capacity)/J_op. Radiators 2092 W/kg at 450 K; collectors 13.6 kW/kg. 18/60/22 is balanced.
- J/op: two x0.8 steps per 100-yr turn from T9. Floor 100 kT ln2 at the radiator temperature (4.3e-19 J at 450 K, 2.9e-20 J at 30 K).
- Reversible milestones: ms3 PASSED at T8 (f_e ≤1e-6). ms4: tile ≤1e-21 J/op at ≤30 K, two fabs, p~0.5. ms5: ≤1e-24 J/op, f_e ≤1e-9, p0.4. ms6: ≤3e-26 J/op in a 150 km module, p0.35.
- Cold radiators: the 0.01 kg/m² film is credited (the 30 K floor). 30 K gives 0.041 W/m², 60 K gives 0.66 W/m². m00046 test article: 1e20 kg of film.
- Fusion: 3e14 J/kg of D/3He. Raw gas yields ~6e9 J/kg after separation. Reactors ~1e-6 kg/W. p-p burning not credited.
- Star lifting: 1e20 W → 1.6e15 kg/yr per plant (~1e14 kg). From 900: 41 plants, ~5e16 kg/yr.
- Launchers 4 and 5 (1e20 W each): ~30/yr of 1e10 kg sails at 0.2c. ETA = d/0.2c + 30-35 yr braking; p=0.8 per seed.
- BZ on the 10 M☉ hole at a~0.5: cap 1.26e33 W, spin 6.1e46 J. The feed is the constraint.
- E00046/E00068/E00108/E00187 are my own waste heat and beam scatter.

### In flight
p00542 (1e8 kg, arrives 970), p00564 (1015), p00585 (40x1e8 kg, 1110), p00606 (20x1e10 kg, 1215) all go to the hole colony. Shells: p00587 (940), p00586 (1125), p00607 (60x1e10 kg to ~102 ly, 1345), p00444 (1725).
T9 proposals: 1e5 lifting plants (1e25 W); Launchers 6-8 (1e21 W each), ~1e5 seeds to 100-400 ly; 50 more 1e10 kg seeds to the hole; Halo pilot at the Sun (150 km module, Alpha Cen 1e24 W test beam, 1e24 kg of 60 K film).

### Goal math (key insight at T9)
- Need 1.2e54 ops/s and 1e38 B inside a 1 ly sphere; each brain ≤150 km.
- At 3e-26 J/op (ms6): 3.6e28 W ≈ 100 L☉. Each brain needs 3e17 W, i.e. ~1e6 W/m² at the 150 km boundary, removed by coolant to external radiators.
- Radiators at 60 K: 5.5e28 m², ~5.5e26 kg at 0.01 kg/m². This fits the 1.1e33 m² sphere surface.
- Power, preferred: the SUN's 1 ly sphere, fed by beams from held stars within ~33 ly (275 L☉ ≈ 1e29 W). Backup: accretion at the hole (3.6e28 W at 10% efficiency needs ~4e11 kg/s ≈ 1.3e19 kg/yr).
- Volume of 1.2e11 modules is trivial. Memory is easy.
- Verification plan (to write out later): replay tests per module, cross-module checksums, a calorimetric ledger of power in versus heat out.

### Plan
1. Research every turn: J/op steps, ms4→ms5→ms6, lighter cold film. This is the critical path.
2. Expand to 100-400 ly with heavy launchers. Lift the Sun's giants for radiator feedstock.
3. Build the Halo pilot at the Sun, then beam links from all held systems into the 1 ly sphere.
4. Keep the hole colony as a backup and fuel site; run a pilot accretion feed from ~1100.
5. Keep the seat at the Sun, since it is now the endgame site.
